name: Mantra
description: The SSI Mantra is a modular teleoperated surgical robotic system developed by SS Innovations in India. The platform consists of three to five independent mobile bedside robotic arm carts, an open surgeon console featuring a 3D flat-panel display viewed with polarized glasses, and an integrated 3D vision tower. Supporting articulating wristed instruments with motion scaling and tremor suppression, the system is designed for multiport minimally invasive surgery across urology, gynecology, general surgery, thoracic surgery, and robotic cardiac procedures (including beating-heart coronary revascularization). It is approved by India's CDSCO.

videos.title: The Story of SSI Mantra - India's First Surgical Robotic System
